transcript: I'd have said I'm captain, and it's my name, under hers, in two books, and I'd go to the order myself and tell them why, and I'd break it. He breathed carefully, and then I'd have minded it for the rest of my life. I'd like it known I'm glad I don't have to. The board combed the hunts' bags back at the gate on the timber pond, as the clique had said it would, from four until after six. Every four came in off the longshore with its bags, and every bag went on the long table under the mast, and a clerk in grey held a comb over it, and another clerk wrote down what the comb said. The queue went back along the boards, and round the end of the graving's wall. Nobody talked much in it. The word had gone along the causeway, and along the mole, and into the town long before any of them came in, and the queue had heard it, and it stood with its bags at its feet, and waited. . . . .
